Name: Simple Clear Cues
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[size=6][b]Simple Clear Cues[/b][/size]

[size=4]Adds on-screen captions for selected sounds and game events, with optional controller vibration.[/size]

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Fishing bites, panning spots and telephone calls.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Nearby enemy warnings, bombs, newly revealed mine ladders and shafts.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Nearby machine completion, falling trees, breaking rocks and other world sounds. Footsteps, weather, doors and pet sounds are optional.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Inventory-full warnings, tool charging, failed placement and shop purchases.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Low health, low energy and timed buff expiry.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Settings[/b][/size]
[size=4]Open the inventory and select the fish button, or enter [b]clear_cues settings[/b] in the SMAPI console. Supports mouse, keyboard and controller.
Enable individual cues and adjust text size, opacity, position and duration. Repeated events can share a caption with a count.
Vibration is off by default. It requires a compatible controller and the game's controller and vibration options enabled. Use [b]Start test[/b] to try a pattern. Includes 12 languages.[/size]

[size=5][b]Requirements & installation[/b][/size]
[size=4]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15 on PC and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.4 or later.
Extract [b]SimpleClearCues[/b] into the game's [b]Mods[/b] folder and launch through SMAPI. When updating, replace the old folder's files and keep [b]config.json[/b]. Keep only one copy.
To uninstall, close the game and remove the SimpleClearCues folder.[/size]

[size=5][b]Limitations[/b][/size]
[size=4]Captions cover selected events, not every sound. Machine alerts report nearby completion, not every ready machine. Nearby threat detection is limited to the current screen and ten tiles, with opaque map walls blocking detection. Custom sound or shop replacements may bypass cues.
No screen-reader narration or automated fishing/combat. Android and multiplayer compatibility are unverified.[/size]

[size=5][b]Bug reports[/b][/size]
[size=4]Include your game, SMAPI and mod versions, steps to reproduce, and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url] for errors.

Created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Xsyy]xSyy[/url].[/size]
